question: A, B and C invested a sum in the ratio of 8 : 36 : 76, respectively. If they earned a total profit of ₹3,030 at the end of the year, what is the difference between the shares of B and C?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of investments A : B : C = 8 : 36 : 76 = 2 : 9 : 19

Total profit parts = 2 + 9 + 19 = 30 parts

Value of 30 parts = ₹3,030 ⇒ 1 part = ₹101

Difference between shares of B and C = 19 − 9 = 10 parts

Difference in amount = 10 × 101 = ₹1,010

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,010.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Investment ratio of A, B and C = 8 : 36 : 76

Total profit earned at the end of the year = ₹3,030

**Formula Used:**

Profit Share = (Individual Investment Ratio ÷ Total Investment Ratio) × Total Profit

**Calculations:**

⇒ Simplified investment ratio of A, B and C = 8 : 36 : 76 = 2 : 9 : 19

⇒ Total ratio parts = 2 + 9 + 19 = 30 parts

⇒ B's profit share = (9 ÷ 30) × 3030

⇒ B's profit share = 9 × 101 = ₹909

⇒ C's profit share = (19 ÷ 30) × 3030

⇒ C's profit share = 19 × 101 = ₹1,919

⇒ Difference between shares of B and C = 1919 − 909 = ₹1,010

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,010.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Partnership Basic Rule

When investments are made for different time periods, the profit is distributed in the ratio of the product of capital and time (Profit Ratio = C₁×T₁ : C₂×T₂).

Sleeping vs Working Partner

A sleeping partner only invests capital, while a working partner also manages the business and usually receives a fixed salary or a certain percentage of the profit before the remainder is split according to the investment ratio.

Calculating Unknown Capitals or Time

If the profit ratio and time ratio are given, the ratio of investments can be found by dividing the profit parts by the time parts (Capital Ratio = P₁÷T₁ : P₂÷T₂).
